content.what_it_is: MATLAB six-panel cohesive-vessel wake plotter. It loads half-domain depth only to derive a mirrored 2n-1 grid (L2-L14), defines output files 40/80/120 and displayed times 200/400/600 s (L18-L24), creates six tight subplots (L27-L31), then per file loads eta/mask/concentration, masks and mirrors eta/C, and plots paired elevation/concentration panels (L33-L79). It saves wakes_cohesive_sed.jpg at L80.
entities: nfile output indices and min time-label cells @L18,L20
unresolved: Displayed times are a separate hand-maintained string array `min` (L20,L54) rather than derived from nfile (L18). The current pairs imply 5 seconds per output index, but no cadence parameter or length-equality check ties the two arrays together; edits can silently mislabel frames or index beyond the labels.
The variable name `min` at L20 shadows MATLAB's built-in `min` for the remainder of the workspace/script, which can break later added minimum calculations.
No shape checks ensure dep, eta, mask, and ch conform before mask indexing and mirrored assignments. Fixed axes are not derived from M,N,dx,dy.
